purpose: Pinned comparison baseline for subsequent ORIGINAL v1 deformation repair candidates. This is not an approval record.

grip_report.note: Grip metrics are embedded in the full R2 pose report; this covers both curl_handle and pullup_bar. grip_test_report_r1.json remains supplemental historical evidence.

acceptance_spec.note: Acceptance pass/fail thresholds unchanged; this blob also adds explicit candidate-to-candidate severity comparison tolerances.

comparison_rule: Future repairs should reduce failed checks without increasing the failed-check count or materially worsening severity for any baseline pose/grip. Use scripts/compare_original_v1_deformation_reports.py.
provenance_rule: V8-V15f material remains reference-only. This baseline records ORIGINAL v1 candidate measurements only and authorizes no copying from legacy/reference assets.
